definitions.explanation: Having printed horizontal lines on the page, as in a lined notebook or ruled paper. A common product descriptor for stationery.

examples.japanese: {罫線入|けいせんい}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{罫線入|けいせんい}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{便箋|びんせん}→便箋：11571_binsen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}ける→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Lined writing paper makes it easier to write neatly.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{手帳|てちょう}→手帳：04537_techou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{罫線入|けいせんい}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{無地|むじ}→無地：03990_muji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交互|こうご}→交互：16076_kougo⟧になっている。
examples.english: This planner alternates between lined pages and blank pages.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{罫線|けいせん}→罫線：13865_keisen⟧ (ruled line) and {入|い}り (containing/with). The suffix 〜{入|い}り is productive and means "containing" or "with," as in {砂糖入|さとうい}り (with sugar) or {絵入|えい}り (illustrated).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {罫線入|けいせんい}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧: lined notebook
- {罫線入|けいせんい}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧: ruled paper
- {罫線入|けいせんい}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{便箋|びんせん}→便箋：11571_binsen⟧: lined writing paper

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {横罫|よこけい}: horizontal ruling — specifies horizontal lines
- {方眼|ほうがん}: grid/graph — square grid pattern
- ⟦{無地|むじ}→無地：03990_muji⟧: plain/blank — no lines
- ⟦{罫線|けいせん}→罫線：13865_keisen⟧: ruled line — the base word
